hook.name: CookHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve token launch hook for Uniswap v4 that manages a main liquidity band, charges protocol and creator swap fees via the afterSwap return delta, and atomically graduates a launch when the target price is reached — burning the main band position, re-pooling the raised base as a permanently locked buy-wall position (Position 3), and optionally initiating a TWAP buy program.
